summary: Examples: ansible -i 'host[1:10],' -m ping, and ansible-playbook -i 'localhost,' play.yml.
questions: How do I ping hosts host1 to host10 without an inventory file?
Why do I need a trailing comma with -i localhost?

answer_card.title: advanced_host_list examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible -i 'host[1:10],' -m ping
ansible-playbook -i 'localhost,' play.yml
```

The comma marks the source as a host list rather than a path.
